content.study: Minutes of proceedings. Section 118 requires minutes of general meetings, board meetings and resolutions by circulation, signed and kept as prescribed. The section applies only to the persons, companies, and transactions it names. A filing, approval, or penalty arises only where the section or a rule under it says so. It does not create a power that is reserved to another section or to the Tribunal. Not a verified closure.

sections.heading: Principle
sections.body: Section 118 requires minutes of general meetings, board meetings and resolutions by circulation, signed and kept as prescribed.

sections.heading: Explanation
sections.body: Minutes are evidence of the proceedings. They must be entered within thirty days. Tampering or failure to keep minutes attracts the penalty in the section. Members may inspect general-meeting minutes under s. 119. Secretarial standards notified under s. 118(10) are mandatory to the extent notified.

sections.body: Meeting or circulation; Entry within 30 days; Signing; SS-1 or SS-2 where notified
